_note: Our own data. The squad's own troops, when it has men of its own (a pirate crew, a ship's captains, a merc company owner): squads of ten (one shared HP pool: the rules session's soldier squad unit), whose losses carry over between fights until reinforced. Recruited in person by talking to people (a bar's regulars, a recruiter or fixer, freed prisoners, a beaten crew changing sides), paid in manna with the wallet house rule, else as a favour owed. Upkeep is one ration per squad per day under the food-and-water house rule; hungry troops lose heart and then desert, and side with whoever's stirring up trouble. Fights: allied units (deploy_max squads), or the book's Reinforcements reserve.

bar.text: Anyone in here looking for work with a gun? We pay, and we look after our own.
bar.signed: A handful of the regulars put down their drinks. By closing time you have ten more fighters: {name}.
name: the bar-room volunteers
the night-shift crew
the regulars

recruiter.text: I'm hiring fighters. Who have you got?
recruiter.signed: Ten fighters, vouched for and armed: {name}.
name: the hired guns
the free company
the fixer's ten

prisoners.text: You're free. Anyone who wants to fight with us is welcome.
prisoners.signed: Some of the freed prisoners stay: {name}.
name: the freed prisoners

beaten_crew.text: Your captain's done. Fight for us now, and you eat with us.
name: the turned crew

lines.desert: {name} are gone in the night, packs and rifles with them. Nobody stays where they aren't fed.
lines.with_instigator: {name} are listening to {pilot}. Hungry men follow whoever says it out loud.
lines.lost: {name} were lost to the last man.
lines.refused: Nobody here wants to fight under your name. Not yet.
